name: The NuGroove Project

evidence.note: Band site describes three lineups and a high-energy mashup show across eras.
Street-fair post invites people to spend the afternoon singing and dancing with the band.
Beach-bar post promises feel-good grooves and a little dancing if the mood hits.

dancing.notes: Upbeat mashups of old and new hits at bars, beach spots and street fairs. The band's own posts invite people to sing and dance along, so some freestyle dancing is likely.

description: East Moriches-based cover project that remixes hits from many decades into mashups; it books as a 6-piece show band, a trio (Small Town Gig) or a duo (Stix & Soul).
genres: pop and rock covers from many decades
reviewNotes:
Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Ira's List does not say which of the three lineups plays Daisy's Patchogue. A linktr.ee/nugroove page lists Instagram/Facebook but the direct URLs were not verified.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Social links come from the band's own site: Instagram and TikTok handles are @thenugrooveproject; the Facebook link is a share link that redirects to facebook.com/musicthatvibes (page name not checked without login). YouTube channel @gggonzalez1908 is the manager's channel that the band site links. Booking email and phone are published on the site for bookings, with manager Gary Gonzalez named. The two photos are individual members' promo shots from the 'Meet the Band' page; no full-band live photo on the site. Current description is still accurate.

evidence.note: Band site (East Moriches): three acts under one roof - The NuGroove Project 6-piece show band with mashups across eras, Small Town Gig (3-4 piece) and Stix & Soul (duo); booking email and phone for manager Gary Gonzalez.
NuGroove Project page links YouTube (@gggonzalez1908), a Facebook share link, Instagram and TikTok (@thenugrooveproject).
Shows page: Stix & Soul at Pete's Taverna, Riverhead, Oct 10 (2026).
The site's Facebook share link redirects to facebook.com/musicthatvibes.
